answer: Latency-Vine Threading. Each identity must publish updates as a continuous thread whose inter-message delays match a seeded zephyr schedule: gaps drawn from a heavy-tailed distribution unique to that identity. Validators score timing entropy and reject identities whose arrival gaps cluster too tightly or drift from their seed. Sybils sharing infrastructure emit correlated gap patterns, so each extra identity costs a fresh timing shaper plus dedicated scheduling, making mass registration linear in real traffic-shape effort.
